hooks.text: 选择主猫与副猫融合并继承双方全部特性，可形成一千多种组合
hooks.excerpt: Fusion Mode : Select a primary and a secondary Supercat to fuse. The fused Supercat inherits all traits of both, with over 1,000 combinations for ever-changing combat, growth, and strategy!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 生存模式先用十波抢装备再比最终时长，无尽模式需打通经典二十波解锁
hooks.excerpt: Survival Mode : Collect weapons and items quickly through 10 waves. Compete to see whose build strategy lets them survive longer in the final survival stage! Endless Mode : The fight to save Meow Star never ends! Unlock it after clearing 20 waves in Classic Mode to push your Supercat’s combat limits!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三十五只猫、一百九十件道具与四十五把武器围绕长短板构建协同
hooks.excerpt: 35+ unique Supercats, 190+ items, and 45+ weapons offer endless Roguelike combinations. Each Supercat has strengths and weaknesses—mastering synergies and growth paths is key!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
